title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Incident File. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Three further dealt worlds wait in the re-roll pool: Risograph, Alien Forest, Silk Canopy.

options.label: The Incident File
options.lineage: declassified case files, field reports, evidence logs
options.thesis: A field record that proves the work before it names the role.
options.viewport: An opened case file: tabbed navigation at left, a typed report with a live topology exhibit, and a record summary at right.
options.risk: The file metaphor becomes costume if the work evidence is not specific.

raised.raise: Layered evidence: redaction strips peel back to reveal earlier deployments and leave the history visible.
Two-ink economy: manila, ink, and one signal red across the whole file; no gradients, glass, or extra accents.
Single-environment commitment: the page never leaves the case-file world, so even quiet sections keep the same material and rules.

options.label: The As-Built
options.lineage: network as-built drawings, site survey sheets, title blocks
options.thesis: The portfolio as the network drawing it describes.
options.viewport: A full drafting sheet: a live network as-built across the field, with the name and role in the title block.
options.risk: Precision turns into wallpaper without real topology data.

options.label: Mondo Tech Bulletin
options.thesis: A technical field bulletin where every element is printed in two impossible inks.
options.viewport: Angled masthead, three-column brief, and a glossary margin; the work reads as a systems bulletin.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: glossary terms explain the stack, but the retro-tech frame can read as style first.
options.risk: Two inks overwhelm the proof if the glossary is not strict.

options.label: Decollage Field Layers
options.lineage: torn Paris hoardings and layered campaign posters
options.thesis: A career as layered site records, torn back to expose earlier deployments.
options.viewport: Torn bands of type and paper, with the tear line as the reading order.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the tear is expressive but slows the proof; loses both axes against the case file.
options.risk: The metaphor can hide the current role.

options.label: Safelight Evidence
options.lineage: darkroom safelight bays and developing trays
options.thesis: Security work as a print developing under safelight.
options.viewport: Amber field, timer digits, and a project emerging in the tray.
options.case: Fuses poorly: photographers identify, network buyers do not; the metaphor obscures the service.

options.label: Riso Service Sheet
options.thesis: A service sheet where two spot inks misregister over warm paper.
options.viewport: Bold display type, cut-paper fields, and a spot-colored index rail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the inks signal a design studio, not an infrastructure engineer.
options.risk: Reads playful where trust is the job.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark portfolio with a neon accent, gradient buttons, and glass cards, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hero, stat row, equal project cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other engineer portfolio.
